BrokenExample.description:
A snippet that resolved at the base and doesn't in the working tree: its
region, file, or source is gone.

address.description: Its address, as the page writes it.

problem.description:
The slug of the diagnostic `ascribe check` reports for it
(`snippet-region-missing`).

reason.description: Why it doesn't resolve, in a few words.

added.description: Lines only in the code now.

address.description: Its address, as the page writes it.

file.description: The code file now, from the repository's root.

removed.description: Lines only in the code at the base.

was_file.description: The code file at the base, when it was renamed since.

CommitLine.description: A commit, by its hash and the first line of its message.

subject.description: The first line of its message.

newest.description: The newest, newest first, at most 20.

DriftPage.description: A page with an example that changed or broke.

broken.description: The examples that resolved at the base and don't now, by address.

builds.description:
The builds that show it with a changed example, in the order asked
for.

examples.description:
The examples that changed, by address. Empty when only `broken`
isn't.

page_changed.description:
Whether the page changed apart from its examples: its own file, or
its resolved content through anything else it uses (a fragment, the
content model), in any of those builds. When it didn't, the example
changed and the words around it didn't.

route.description: Its route, in the first of the builds it's in.

Failure.description: A file a snippet names that couldn't be copied.

back.description:
Whether the new pin isn't after the old one: it moved back, or to
another line of history. No commits are counted then.

commits.description:
The commits after the old pin up to the new one, when it moved
forward from one and the repository could say.

failed.description: The files snippets name that couldn't be copied.

first_copy.description: Whether these are the first files copied from the source.

followed.description: The revision followed: `--to`'s, the branch, or `HEAD`.

from.description: The pin before, if it had one.

description:
What `ascribe sources update --format json` writes: how each source's pin
moved, and the pages whose examples the new copies change.

ascribe_version.description: The version of Ascribe that wrote it.

changed.description: Whether any file changed: a copy, or the lock.

pages.description:
The pages whose examples the new copies change, as `ascribe drift
--format json` lists them; `null` when nothing changed, or when that
can't be told.

pages_unavailable.description: Why there are no `pages`, when there aren't.

schema_version.description:
The version of this schema. It changes only when a field is removed
or changes meaning.

sources.description: What the update did for each source, in declaration order.

title: SourcesUpdateReport
